adjudication.rationale: The diff shows in app/controllers/groups_controller.rb line 22: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i`. This is a public endpoint (groups_controller.rb, not admin) that accepts any user-provided limit value without an upper bound. A malicious user could pass limit=999999 to retrieve all members of a large group in one request, bypassing the intended pagination of 50 members. This is a real security/performance defect - there's no maximum cap on the limit parameter.
